# RoboHeard

> Agentic AI orchestration platform. Conductor Mode delegates, debates, and synthesizes responses across GPT-5, Claude 4, Gemini 2.5, Grok-4, DeepSeek-R2, Mistral Large, Perplexity Sonar, and Qwen in real time.

RoboHeard lets you chat with eight frontier AI models at once, orchestrate them with a Conductor agent that plans and delegates work, or compare answers side-by-side. Free Mode runs autonomous multi-agent debates; the Image Studio fans a single prompt across DALL·E, Gemini, Grok, Qwen Wanx, and Pollinations FLUX.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Multi-agent chat workspace with Conductor, Discussion, Isolated, and Side-by-Side modes.

- [Purchase](/purchase): Token packages for accessing the AI models.
- [Images](/images): Multi-provider image generation interface.

## Latest release

- v2.8.0 (2026-06-10) — Fun Mode: Chats That Restyle Themselves: Toggle Fun mode and the chat window evolves its look after each reply — backgrounds, bubbles, accents, and fonts gradually drift to match the conversation's vibe. Readability is always guarded.

## Feature categories

- Eight Frontier Models: Every flagship LLM, in one calm workspace — pick one, compare a few, or run all eight in parallel.
- Four Chat Modes: Match the interaction pattern to your task — collaboration, comparison, or solo focus.
- Agentic Orchestration: Beyond chat — the Conductor turns eight models into one coordinated system.
- Market & Web Research: Grounded answers with citations — not confident guesses.
- Multi-Model Image Studio: One brief, several visual minds. Render once, pick the result that fits.
- Workspace & Controls: Small details that make multi-agent work feel calm instead of chaotic.
- Account & Billing: Transparent pricing, flexible access, no surprises.
- Security & Reliability: Production posture: strict RLS, encrypted secrets, retried calls.
